clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, a handsome bounty calls for the death of Incinerator Gar'im. The hostile orc commander is entrenched in Render's Valley, where he leads shadowcasters and is said to work with the Blackrock clan at Stonewatch Keep. Magistrate Solomon offers the bounty for proof of Gar'im's demise.

Blackrock orcs are pressing out from their mountain strongholds, making the Redridge Mountains more dangerous. In Render's Valley, Gar'im leads an incursion with loyal shadowcasters and dark sorcery. Lakeshire's guard is stretched thin, and the crown's armies are largely absent. Magistrate Solomon has called on independent fighters to eliminate Gar'im, who is said to work with the Blackrock at Stonewatch Keep.

Gar'im is known for destructive magic and command over shadow-weaving casters. To claim the township's reward, hunters must enter enemy-held territory, defeat him, and return his shattered staff to Lakeshire's town hall as proof that the threat has ended.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you have there, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!
